scope.verified: Explicitly initialized Flora players; artifact grants guard; Effect owns contact and transfer; inventory/tick/Effect/modifier integration; no natural-login or HP-damage assertion. Caller-supplied amounts and durations; given initialization and same-amount refresh; pending-given overwrite is investigated separately in core.
scope.fixture: Fresh flat world; protocol clients; first_join and faith tags set explicitly; time advanced with tick step. The Death tag is set directly for condition checks, not a death/respawn lifecycle test. Area entry settles before spectator checks. Final lifecycle checks give/remove Effect 399 through public APIs; an independent modifier UUID belongs only to the test fixture.

gamerule doDaylightCycle false
gamemode creative @a
execute as @a at @s run function core:handler/first_join
